titleEn: Ask the editor AI to change the page: restyle, reorder, hide, add or move blocks, link products, set images and links, fix the phone view

ar: اطلب من الAI يخلي الهيرو اكبر
en: Ask the AI to change my page

steps: Editor > Ask AI, 500 chars, max 12 ops, preview then Apply. The AI sees your products, categories, look, language and the screen size you are looking at; it fills empty places and never replaces words, pictures or links you wrote or chose.
edgeCases: Daily cap 150 requests / 200k tokens per store
Fill-only: existing merchant text, images and links are kept (the preview says how many parts were left as they are); only empty or placeholder places are filled
Products, categories, images and links must be ones this store has: anything else is refused, not saved. Cannot create new pages yet
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Create a page from a request (new landing page) is not built
